title: Notion-like Database Table — full table with import/export (11 views · 16 cells · CSV + JSON)
description: Portable Notion-style database surface. Optional companion to notion-shell. NotionDatabase ships full DB UI with ViewTabs + ViewOptions + per-column menu + 11 views (Table / Board / List / Gallery / Calendar / Feed / Chart / Dashboard / Form / Map / Timeline) + FilterBuilder + SortBuilder + 16 property-cell types (text / number / checkbox / select / multi_select / status / date / url / email / phone / files / person / formula / created_time / last_edited_time / unique_id). FormView submits via onRowCreate callback. Pure / props-driven. Lifted from notion-page-clone (Nosion).

peers.reason: Domain types (Database, Property, PropertyValue, DbView, DatabaseViewConfig, DatabaseFilter, DatabaseSort) live in notion-shell — the Page type references them via rowOfDatabaseId + rowProps so they stay in the shell's domain model.
